children: OBDUCAT has received an order from a German institute for the supply of a wet processing system based on the Company's QSW platform. The order value amounts to SEK 2.3 million and delivery is planned for the first quarter of 2027.

The order relates to a wet processing solution configured to perform various wet chemical processes, including photomask cleaning. The customer is a leading institute focused on the development of smart integrated systems for a range of applications.
The order marks the second QSW wet processing system order received by Obducat during October and reflects continued demand for solutions requiring high process capability, repeatability and control.

Photomask cleaning is a critical process step in advanced lithography processes. Obducat's QSW platform is designed to meet the stringent requirements of both research environments and industrial manufacturing applications.

"We are pleased to see continued demand for our wet processing solutions. Receiving a second order within a short period of time for applications involving photomask cleaning reinforces the attractiveness of our QSW platform and its ability to meet demanding process requirements," says Patrik Lundström, CEO of Obducat.

Obducat AB (publ) is an innovative developer and supplier of technologies, products and processes used for the production and replication of advanced micro and nano structures. Obducat's products and services serve the demands of customers worldwide within the LED and Display, Optics and Photonics, MEMS and Sensor industries as well as in High Power and High Frequency electronics and Biomedical Devices. Obducat's technologies include nano imprint technology, resist- and wet processing technologies. Obducat has its own market presence in Sweden, Germany, Japan, USA, England, Portugal and China and the headquarter is located in Lund, Sweden. Obducat is a public company. The Obducat share is traded on the Swedish NGM Main Regulated Equity exchange. Read more at www.obducat.com or contact us via email
